in_sanskrit.name: निधिष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has hidden treasures, The one who protects treasures

in_hindi.name: निधिष
in_hindi.long_meaning: निधान (Nidhāna) + िष (Iṣa) = The one who has a treasure house, The one who is the lord of treasures

in_tamil.name: நித்திஷ்
in_tamil.meaning: நித்தம் (Nitham) + ஷ் (Śa) = The one who has abundance, The one who is always full
in_tamil.long_meaning: நித்தம் (Nitham) + ஷ் (Śa) + ிச் (Iṣa) = The one who has an abundance of treasures, The one who is the lord of treasures

in_telugu.name: నిధిష్
in_telugu.meaning: నిధి (Nidhi) + ష్ (Śa) = The one who has treasure, The one who is wealthy
in_telugu.long_meaning: నిధి (Nidhi) + ష్ (Śa) + ఇశ్ (Iśa) = The one who is the lord of treasures, The one who has an abundance of wealth

in_marathi.name: Nidhish
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of treasures
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nidhish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nidhish is the name of the Hindu god of wealth, known as Kubera. He is the ruler of Alakapuri, the city of gems. Nidhish is also the god of the serpents and is depicted with a mace and a bowl filled with gold or jewels.

in_bengali.name: Nidhish
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of treasures
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nidhish একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Nidhish is the name of the Hindu god of wealth, known as Kubera. He is the ruler of Alakapuri, the city of gems. Nidhish is also the god of the serpents and is depicted with a mace and a bowl filled with gold or jewels.
